lines.en: My axe drags behind me
Wet prints stay on the stone
I climb out of the water and walk
Seawater drips from my robe
I press along the shoreline
My shell grinds with each step
I heave the axe at my hip
I close on the village, step by step
Weeds tangle round my ankle
I stoop and shuffle forward
My shadow is blacker in water
I round a wet boulder
I shift from the shallows onto stone
My robe clings to my legs as I walk
I advance along the waterline
The sand sinks under my steps
I stand still at the water's edge
My gill covers open and close
I shake the water off my axe
My head tilts a little
I listen to the shore
Salt crusts over my shell
When the tide sounds, I raise my head
I stare toward the village
Seawater runs from my fingers
I have no need of this air

lines.zh: 我把斧刃在腿上蹭了蹭
lines.en: I wipe the blade on my leg
My voice stays stuck in my throat
I wait for the tide to rise
I tap the haft once and again
I've kept your face in my gills
You smell of dry land
My gills flare and close
You are not like the village folk
I lift the axe head an inch
I'm counting how many steps you have left
I know the sound of your breath
You will not run far on land

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在盐水里发亮
lines.en: My eyes shine in the brine
I can smell your blood too
The flesh under my shell is jumping
A gap opens in my shell
My blood is a dark color
I drive my axe handle into the mud
I grip the axe tighter
I lower my head and lick the wound
My gills clamp shut
Pain only makes me hungrier
I can still stand on my own
You have angered me now
I do not eat your bread
You drop meat by the water
That smell means little to me
I want only what still lives
Take the food away
My meals are not served
That cannot fill me
I prefer it when it struggles
You are wasting your arm
I take no such kindness
You hit my shell
My haft stops you
Seawater squeezes between us
You are shoved back two steps
I am slippery as a fish
My shoulder is harder than it looks
The knock scatters along the shore
You cannot grip my robe
I turn aside and come back
You stepped in my print
The seaborn call from the deep
Others of my kind are ashore
We have no need of pairing
The tide will carry us
I remember only the sound of the sea
This is not my concern
We have no names
I listen to the distant echo
One sea bred us all
I go forward, never back
I pick up wet wood
This could hone my blade
I close my fist on it
I put it in my mouth to test
This is not soft enough
I fling it into the water
I pick up a fallen emerald
It feels cold in my palm
I tuck it at my waist
I will take these fragments
Something lives on the shore
You crossed my shoreline
I have raised the axe
I feel the heat off you
This one can be carried back
My gills flare open
The prey is on dry ground
You cannot leave the tideline
I lock onto your scent
The blade is already on you
I step in your footprints as I follow
Run, I can hear you
My prints chase yours
I don't run; I measure you with my axe
You slipped on the wet clay
I wait for you to turn
My axe is overhead
Do not count on the iron golem
The straight line works for me
You would do better to reach water
The axe bites your shoulder
I sweep it across
The haft hits your chest
I shove you into the mud
This swing splits the fence
I bite into your forearm
The axe falls with a wet gleam

lines.zh: 你挡了斧，没挡住我的手
lines.en: You stop the axe, not my hand
I drag you toward the water
Your blood blooms red in the mud
The tide pushes up a figure
I walk up out of the sea
My axe breaks the surface first
The water at the shore churns

lines.zh: 湿漉漉的甲在月光下亮
lines.en: Wet shell glints in moonlight
I shake the water off
I push out of the kelp
I stand on dry ground
Brine runs from my robe
The shoreline has a new owner
Fire dries my gills
My shell cracks on landing
Back in water, I somehow sink
The blast tears my robe
An arrow sticks in my shell

lines.zh: 咒光在我的湿甲上炸开
lines.en: Magic bursts on my wet shell
Hunger makes my axe unsteady

lines.zh: 雷电顺着水走遍我全身
lines.en: Lightning rides the water through me

lines.zh: 下坠时我听见海的回声
lines.en: Falling, I hear the sea echo
